# Drafts (fixture: clean)

## best/

The night the monitor alarmed, I learned that staying calm is a skill I could practice, not a
trait I was born with. My hands shook. The resident looked at me, and I counted the beats out
loud because it was the only thing I could think to do. Later she told me the counting had helped
her too. That lesson still steadies my hands today, and it is why I want a training program that
lets me practice under pressure with people who will tell me when I am wrong.
